# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

Advanced Cancer Treatment Navigation

## What does CancerFax do?

"Advanced cancer treatment guidance, clinical trial matching, and care coordination are three
pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the
current treatment plan, identify overlooked options, and provide greater confidence before an
important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

We help you understand which advanced treatment options may be relevant to your diagnosis, disease
stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India,
and the USA. Our team conducts an initial eligibility review, communicates with trial centers, and
guides patients through screening, documentation, and enrollment.

### End-to-End Care Coordination

From preparing medical documents and communicating with hospitals to appointment scheduling, visa
assistance, travel planning, admission support, and continuity of care, CancerFax coordinates the
complete treatment journey. This allows patients and their families to focus on treatment while we
manage the clinical and logistical details.

### Compassionate Support

Human guidance for patients and families navigating difficult decisions, with emphasis on clarity,
honesty, and realistic, informed hope.

Access trusted second opinions from global cancer specialists, ensuring every diagnosis, treatment

# Doubling up on pads? ✳︎ Bleeding through clothes? ✳︎ Period longer than 7 days? ✳︎ Missing work?

### **1 in 5 women suffer from heavy menstrual bleeding.¹**

With bleeding that soaks through menstrual products for hours or days in a row, it can feel
impossible to keep up with all of your normal daily activities – always worrying about having a
bathroom nearby.

[ Learn More ][61]

## Introducing Cerene® Cryotherapy

Cerene is a treatment designed to provide relief from your heavy and painful periods, getting you
back to a life controlled by you, not your period.
* **2 1/2 minute treatment time using cooling technology**
* **No anesthesia needed**
* **No incisions**
* **Done right in your doctor’s office**

[ Learn more ][62]

## Real Patient Results

#### reported normal, light, or no periods after Cerene†

#### had a reduction in cramping‡

#### would recommend Cerene to family and friends†††

† Patient-reported data are 1 year after treatment with durable results at 3 years
‡ Improvement reported one year after treatment for patients reporting severe / very severe cramping
††† Patient-reported data include definitely and consider recommending Cerene and are 1 year after
treatment with durable results at 3 years

[ Clinical Outcomes ][63]

### Providers

### Patients

**Important Safety Information**

Cerene® Cryotherapy Device is indicated to ablate the endometrial lining of the uterus in
premenopausal women with heavy menstrual bleeding due to benign causes for whom childbearing is
complete. Pregnancy following the Cerene procedure can be dangerous; therefore, contraception must
be used until menopause. The Cerene procedure is not for those who have or suspect uterine cancer;
have an active genital, urinary or pelvic infection; or an IUD. There are risks and considerations
associated with the use of the Cerene Cryotherapy Device. Temporary side effects may include uterine
cramping, vaginal infection, and lightheadedness. For detailed benefit and risk information, consult
the Cerene Instructions for Use (IFU) or your healthcare professional. CAUTION: Federal (USA) law
restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician trained in the use of the Cerene
Cryotherapy Device. [**Learn More**][64]

# Doubling up on pads? ✳︎ Bleeding through clothes? ✳︎ Period longer than 7 days? ✳︎ Missing work?

### **1 in 5 women suffer from heavy menstrual bleeding.¹**

With bleeding that soaks through menstrual products for hours or days in a row, it can feel
impossible to keep up with all of your normal daily activities – always worrying about having a
bathroom nearby.

[ Learn More ][61]

## Introducing Cerene® Cryotherapy

Cerene is a treatment designed to provide relief from your heavy and painful periods, getting you
back to a life controlled by you, not your period.
* **2 1/2 minute treatment time using cooling technology**
* **No anesthesia needed**
* **No incisions**
* **Done right in your doctor’s office**

[ Learn more ][62]

## Real Patient Results

#### reported normal, light, or no periods after Cerene†

#### had a reduction in cramping‡

#### would recommend Cerene to family and friends†††

† Patient-reported data are 1 year after treatment with durable results at 3 years
‡ Improvement reported one year after treatment for patients reporting severe / very severe cramping
††† Patient-reported data include definitely and consider recommending Cerene and are 1 year after
treatment with durable results at 3 years

[ Clinical Outcomes ][63]

### Providers

### Patients

**Important Safety Information**

Cerene® Cryotherapy Device is indicated to ablate the endometrial lining of the uterus in
premenopausal women with heavy menstrual bleeding due to benign causes for whom childbearing is
complete. Pregnancy following the Cerene procedure can be dangerous; therefore, contraception must
be used until menopause. The Cerene procedure is not for those who have or suspect uterine cancer;
have an active genital, urinary or pelvic infection; or an IUD. There are risks and considerations
associated with the use of the Cerene Cryotherapy Device. Temporary side effects may include uterine
cramping, vaginal infection, and lightheadedness. For detailed benefit and risk information, consult
the Cerene Instructions for Use (IFU) or your healthcare professional. CAUTION: Federal (USA) law
restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician trained in the use of the Cerene
Cryotherapy Device. [**Learn More**][64]

# Luxury Cold Wellness. Built Colder. Built Better.

CryoBuilt designs and manufactures ultra-low-temperature cryotherapy systems for operators,
institutions, and private clients who demand performance, longevity, and absolute control over their
cold wellness environment.

Request Equipment Information
[ [chillybox cryo chamber] ][32]

### Chillybox

A true plug-and-play system built for private residences & light commercial use, bringing
professional cryotherapy into the comfort of home or boutique wellness offering.

[ Learn more ][33]
[ [Cryobuilt Polaris] ][34]

### Polaris

Polaris is a self-contained electric cryotherapy chamber within CryoBuilt’s equipment portfolio,
purpose-built for single-user sessions in professional environments with appropriate hosting
conditions.

[ Learn more ][35]

### Everest

Fully electric cryotherapy equipment engineered for high-throughput environments, supporting
multi-user sessions with sustained ultra-low-temperature performance during continuous operation.

[ Learn more ][36]
[ [Cryobuilt Tundra] ][37]

### Tundra

Tundra is CryoBuilt’s most refined electric cryotherapy chamber, the luxury platform within the
CryoBuilt portfolio. While other models scale for height or capacity, Tundra is engineered around
spatial experience, airflow orientation, and architectural precision.

[ Learn more ][38]

### Nordic

CryoBuilt’s largest electric cryotherapy equipment, engineered for multi-user capacity and sustained
ultra-low-temperature performance in high-volume professional environments.

[ Learn more ][39]

### Accessories

Purpose-built accessories designed to enhance performance, comfort, and the cryotherapy experience.

[ Learn more ][41]

# Cryotherapy Machine
# Manufacturer

One-stop cryotherapy shop with tailor-made solutions adapted for any location or budget.

## [Cryotherapy Equipment][90]

### [Local Cryotherapy Devices][91]

Cryofans are body care devices for localized treatments operating on vaporized nitrogen. Cryomed's
cryoblowers work with extremely low temperatures ranging from -80℃ to -120℃. Spot cryotherapy
devices are widely used in beauty salons, health clinics or med spas, recovery labs, fitness and
wellness centers.

### [Whole-Body Cryotherapy Machines][92]

A cryosauna is an open-top device for whole-body cryogenic treatments. Such cryotherapy machine
rapidly cools down the skin with freezingly cold nitrogen vapor and air mix. The resulting thermal
shock prompts reduced inflammation and pain relief, energy boost, and lower stress levels. A series
of treatments produces far-reaching positive effects, like managing chronic pain, improving
immunity, shedding extra weight, and boosting vitality.

### [Mobile Cryotherapy Equipment][93]

Forget about improvised mobile cryotherapy rooms. Meet a new offer from Cryomed: a minibus with the
tastefully decorated interior fully equipped for a quality cryotherapy experience on the go! Our
mobile cryotherapy unit – Cryobus – is now available for our customers worldwide.

Our factory works according to quality system management [ISO 13485][94]

All our products are [CE certified][95].

Guaranteed quality for all cryotherapy devices.

## Global Cryotherapy Machine Manufacturer

One-stop cryotherapy shop with tailor-made solutions adapted for any location or budget.

[Start Cryo Business in Your Town]

# Start cryo business now!

Cryotherapy market has been steadily growing over the past few years. Become an owner of a cryo
center offering both whole-body and local cryotherapy treatments!

You can rely on our expertise, as we have been manufacturing cryotherapy equipment since 2002. We
offer cryosaunas, or cryo chambers, for whole-body cryotherapy with the temperatures ranging from
-110°C to -180°C. In addition, we manufacture cryogenic blowers for spot treatments with a stream of
nitrogen vapors as cold as -100°C to -130°C. Our quality management system for cryotherapy equipment
complies with ISO 13485 standards. All our products are CE [certified][65]. Read also: [How to start
cryotherapy business?][66]

[Cryomed Pro Beauty][67]

Cryosauna Cryomed Pro is an ideal ergonomic and practical solution for beauty parlors, cosmetic
salons, dermatology clinics, wellness centers and hotels.

The ability of cold therapy and cryogenic sessions to accelerate cell regeneration and lymphatic
drainage, improve the face tone, and cure skin diseases makes Cryomed Pro an indispensable assistant
in beauty industry.

Contact us for details and advice!

[SPECIFICATIONS OF CRYOMED PRO][68]
[Cryotherapy Machines Manufacturer]
[Cryomed Pro Sport][69]

Whole body cryotherapy is the well-kept secret of the world’s best athletes including Christiano
Ronaldo, Floyd Mayweather or LeBron James.

It is currently the most efficient and most comprehensive method of recovery, used both in
professional and in a recreational sport. And it could be the vital detail leading to success!

Cryotherapy machine Cryomed Pro is the best choice for athletes and people leading a healthy
lifestyle.

[SPECIFICATIONS OF CRYOMED PRO][70]
[Best Cryotherapy Machines]
[Cryomed One][71]

Cryomed One is the only cryosauna in the cryotherapy market with a one-step installation and just
one square meter of space required. Moreover, it features extremely low liquid nitrogen consumption
and flexibility in feeding system, easily switching between pressurized tanks and unpressurized
Dewars.

Contact us for further details and options, and boost your business with Cryomed One!

[SPECIFICATIONS OF CRYOMED ONE][72]
[New-generation device for local cryotherapy]
[Cryofan CF-05][73]

Cryofan CF-05 is an advanced new-generation cryotherapy machine for local cryotherapy treatments.

Modern, compact, and mobile, it brings cryotherapy closer to consumers through reasonable pricing,
ease of use, and cost of ownership.

It’s a perfect solution for medical, wellness and fitness centers, gyms, beauty salons,
rehabilitation facilities, training camps, and even individual users interested in fast and free
access to an unlimited number of cryogenic treatments.

**Feedback from Our Clients**
* ## “We had such a great experience with Bailey caring for our animals – and all of them. We have
  ## donkeys, mules, pigs and chickens! Even when our plans changed at the last minute she was very
  ## accommodating and flexible to ensure our animals were well cared for. Everyone seemed happy and

  ## entrusting Bailey to care for our animals again! Highly recommend!”

# Fig & Honey Horse Care

### FAQ’s
* #### I have other animals besides horses, will your services apply?
  
  Yes, absolutely. If you have other animals that need our services, we would be happy to provide
  what is needed. We are experienced and fully insured for household pet care as well as equine
  care! Additional costs may apply.
* #### What geographical areas do we service?
  
  Serving Berkshire County and parts of Hampshire County. Contact us to see if you are within our
  service range!
* #### What times are we available for services?
  
  Our hours depend on your needs! If you require early morning or late night care, we are here to
  help. Call or email today to schedule an appointment.
* #### Don't see the service you are looking for?
  
  The services we provide are not limited to what is listed above. If you do not see the service you
  require, please reach out to me via email or phone so that we can best assist you.
* #### Cancellation Policy
  
  We value your time and our resources. To ensure that we can serve all our clients fairly, please
  review our cancellation policy.
  
  Cancellation Notice:
  
  Cancellations made two weeks before of services will forfeit the deposit placed during booking.
  
  Emergencies:
  
  We understand that emergencies happen. In the event of illness or an emergency, please contact us
  as soon as possible. We may waive the cancellation fee at our discretion.

## Contact Us

Interested in working together? Fill out some info and we will be in touch shortly. We can’t wait to
hear from you!

Please call or email to schedule an appointment:

Email: [fighoneyhc@gmail.com][23]

Phone Number: [413-464-3485][24]

# Fig & Honey Horse Care

### FAQ’s
* #### I have other animals besides horses, will your services apply?
  
  Yes, absolutely. If you have other animals that need our services, we would be happy to provide
  what is needed. We are experienced and fully insured for household pet care as well as equine
  care! Additional costs may apply.
* #### What geographical areas do we service?
  
  Serving Berkshire County and parts of Hampshire County. Contact us to see if you are within our
  service range!
* #### What times are we available for services?
  
  Our hours depend on your needs! If you require early morning or late night care, we are here to
  help. Call or email today to schedule an appointment.
* #### Don't see the service you are looking for?
  
  The services we provide are not limited to what is listed above. If you do not see the service you
  require, please reach out to me via email or phone so that we can best assist you.
* #### Cancellation Policy
  
  We value your time and our resources. To ensure that we can serve all our clients fairly, please
  review our cancellation policy.
  
  Cancellation Notice:
  
  Cancellations made two weeks before of services will forfeit the deposit placed during booking.
  
  Emergencies:
  
  We understand that emergencies happen. In the event of illness or an emergency, please contact us
  as soon as possible. We may waive the cancellation fee at our discretion.

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,

### Ameliyatsız Bel ve
### Boyun Fıtığı Tedavileri

Ozon, radyofrekans veya lazer diskektomi yöntemlerinden kişiye uygun olanseçilerek fıtığın içine
iğne ile girerek küçültücü işlem (farmako termal regresyon) yapılır. Yaklaşık 3 ay içinde fıtık
geriler ve sinir basısı azalır.

[Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi][Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi]

### Ameliyatsız Tiroid
### Tedavisi

Ciltten girimle (Radyofrekans, Mikrodalga, Kriyoablasyon) nodül yakılarak (ablasyon) ya da çok büyük
guatrlarda ve de Basedow Graves hastalığında embolizasyon yöntemiyle, ameliyatsız olarak 30 dakikada
tedavi sağlanır. Nodüller küçülür ve semptomlar giderilir ve hastalar tiroid ilacı kullanmazlar.

[Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri][Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri]

### Kanser Hastalıkları
### Tedavileri

Kanser tedavisinde girişimsel radyoloji yöntemleriyle, tümöre doğrudan hedeflenen tedaviler
uygulanabilir. Tümör besleyici damarların tıkandığı kemoembolizasyon, radyofrekans ve mikrodalga
ablasyon gibi yöntemlerle sağlıklı dokular korunarak tedavi gerçekleştirilir. Bu tedaviler,
cerrahiye uygun olmayan veya ek tedaviye ihtiyaç duyan uygun hastalarda güvenle kullanılabilir.

[Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi][Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi]

### Erektil Disfonksiyon
### Tedavisi

Organik sertleşme sorununun çoğunluğunu damarsal sertleşme bozuklukları oluşturur. Genç yaşlarda
çoğunlukla toplardamar kaçakları sebep olur ve embolizasyon yapılabilir. Atar damar kökenli olanlar
ileri yaşlarda ortaya çıkar. Tıkalı damarların balon veya stent ile tedavisi hedeflenir.

[Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi][Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi]

### Beyin Damar
### Hastalıkları Tedavisi

Beyin damar tıkanıklıkları, anevrizmalar ve damar yumakları gibi hastalıklar, anjiyografik
yöntemlerle uygun hastalarda ameliyatsız olarak tedavi edilebilir. Balon, stent ve coil uygulamaları
sayesinde damar içinden yapılan girişimlerle kan akımı düzenlenir ve beyin dokusu korunur. Erken
tanı ve hızlı müdahale, kalıcı hasar riskini önemli ölçüde azaltır.

## Tedaviler

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, İstanbul’da damar ve organ hastalıklarının tanı ve tedavisinde minimal
invaziv yöntemler uygulayan deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktorudur. Modern görüntüleme
sistemleri eşliğinde cerrahi gerektirmeyen, güvenli ve etkili tedavi çözümleri sunar.

Girişimsel radyoloji, anjiyo, embolizasyon, biyopsi, tümör ablasyonu, varis ve damar
tıkanıklıklarının tedavisi gibi işlemleri kapsar. Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, bu işlemleri
ultrason, bilgisayarlı tomografi (BT) ve anjiyografi rehberliğinde yüksek hassasiyetle
gerçekleştirir.

Deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktoru olarak Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, karaciğer tümörleri,
rahim miyomları, böbrek ve damar hastalıklarında cerrahiye alternatif minimal invaziv teknikler
uygular. Bu yöntemler, hastada daha az ağrı, daha kısa iyileşme süresi ve düşük komplikasyon riski
sağlar.

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, her hastası için kişiye özel tedavi planı oluşturur. Multidisipliner
yaklaşımıyla onkoloji, kalp-damar cerrahisi ve nöroloji uzmanlarıyla iş birliği yaparak en uygun
çözümü sunar. Hedef; etkin, güvenli ve hastaya konfor sağlayan tedavidir.

## Tedaviler

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, İstanbul’da damar ve organ hastalıklarının tanı ve tedavisinde minimal
invaziv yöntemler uygulayan deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktorudur. Modern görüntüleme
sistemleri eşliğinde cerrahi gerektirmeyen, güvenli ve etkili tedavi çözümleri sunar.

Girişimsel radyoloji, anjiyo, embolizasyon, biyopsi, tümör ablasyonu, varis ve damar
tıkanıklıklarının tedavisi gibi işlemleri kapsar. Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, bu işlemleri
ultrason, bilgisayarlı tomografi (BT) ve anjiyografi rehberliğinde yüksek hassasiyetle
gerçekleştirir.

Deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktoru olarak Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, karaciğer tümörleri,
rahim miyomları, böbrek ve damar hastalıklarında cerrahiye alternatif minimal invaziv teknikler
uygular. Bu yöntemler, hastada daha az ağrı, daha kısa iyileşme süresi ve düşük komplikasyon riski
sağlar.

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, her hastası için kişiye özel tedavi planı oluşturur. Multidisipliner
yaklaşımıyla onkoloji, kalp-damar cerrahisi ve nöroloji uzmanlarıyla iş birliği yaparak en uygun
çözümü sunar. Hedef; etkin, güvenli ve hastaya konfor sağlayan tedavidir.
